question: Can a known finite latent second-order recurrence be recovered under an initially unknown four-symbol relabeling, using bounded supervised observations and refusing to guess while multiple candidate predictive rules remain?
hypothesis: Searching all 24 symbol permutations by transition consistency recovers a unique observable next-symbol rule from a sufficient set of labels, while early incomplete calibration can leave genuinely ambiguous predictive mappings and cause justified abstention.
generator: Latent recurrence x[t]=(x[t-1]+x[t-2]) modulo4 for 32 ticks; x0=(episode+seed)%4, x1=((episode//4)+3*seed)%4 across episodes0..15. For fresh seeds112..119 observed symbol is pi_seed[x], where pi_seed is an index into lexicographically sorted 24 permutations chosen by first SHA256('W26/'+decimal seed) byte mod24; no rule labels or pi_seed provided to predictor.
calibration: For each budget k, show only observed tick0,tick1,tick2 triples of episodes 0..k-1, k fixed from {4,8,16}; test only t3..31 of all sixteen episodes, 16x29=464 predictions per seed. The predictor never receives any tested t>=3 label. All calibration episodes are identified; use the same test set for all budgets.
arms: no_adaptation: directly assume observed labels follow additive mod4 recurrence (identity encoding)

enumeration_k4: all24 candidate inverses, retain those consistent with 4 triples; accept only if all surviving hypotheses predict identically on ALL 16 possible ordered raw context pairs, otherwise abstain
metrics: For each seed and budget: count consistent permutations, count distinct induced 16-context prediction tables, accepted/abstained status, test 4x4 confusion and accuracy if accepted, and test-label-independent table SHA. Report coverage and accepted accuracy, and baseline raw-additive accuracy.
primary: REPRESENTATION_RECOVERY if k16 accepts all eight seeds, makes zero incorrect predictions and k16 coverage>=k4, while no_adaptation aggregate accuracy<0.9; PARTIAL if at least one seed accepted correctly; NEGATIVE otherwise. Reject any inconsistent/ambiguous symbolic rules rather than choosing a favorable hypothesis post-result.
bounds: 24 fixed permutations, 16 possible input contexts, four raw symbols, at most sixteen labeled t2 transitions per seed; labels explicitly budgeted per level, no hidden model calls/capacity increase or extra heldout feedback. Preflight synthetic permutation fixture only, exact Git blob, original first-use archival and full Go regression.
claim_limit: Predeclared finite alphabet-isomorphism search with supervised anchors and known latent dynamics, not unconstrained representation learning or natural-language cognition.
